review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: What You'll Do Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues escalated from L1 support via email, chat, or ticketing systems Reproduce bugs, investigate root causes, and escalate to engineering with clear, detailed reports Monitor system performance and proactively flag potential issues Write and maintain internal documentation, FAQs, and troubleshooting guides Collaborate with product and engineering teams to improve product reliability and customer experience Track and report on support metrics (response time, resolution time, customer satisfaction) Provide occasional onboarding or technical guidance to new customers Mentor and support L1 engineers on technical troubleshooting What We're Looking For 5+ years of experience in a technical support, application support, or related engineering role Strong understanding of web technologies (APIs, databases, networking basics) Familiarity
